evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A categorical distinction framed as a logical premise — argument from definitional contrast, no authority or pressure invoked.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Logical contrast (commodity vs. asset) carries rational-persuasion; the valuing of perspective as what 'you keep' appeals to a vision of self-possession.
